scope: B frozen tools and controlled integration plan only; not A candidate, installation, runtime or product acceptance
sourceFindings: Installed ASAR main/preload/desktop-host source independently matched the extracted source hashes in preflight-plan.json.
Official dsh-app://app proxy adds Host authentication privately; client uses same-origin fetch and never reads token/cookie.
Public product bridge exposes no quit. CloseMainWindow hides; fixed main inspector app.quit uses official before-quit path, awaits backend close subject to official quit confirmation.
Client permits three management reads, explicitly enabled fixed-spec install, fixed registration receipt read. createDesktopManager exposes no caller-supplied RPC/eval/options.
safeManagerResult projects selected fields and compatibility requirements; raw package output/diagnostics/registry excluded. This is field projection, not arbitrary-string secret classification.
Archive parser is read-only and bounds packed paths/data; tests cover traversal and unpacked denial.
conditions: Controller verifies and records renderer/main loopback listeners and target identities belong to this controlled instance. connectDesktopManager validates loopback WS but does not bind returned WS port to inventory port itself.
Only createDesktopManager fixed install options are within this plan; exported managerExpression accepts more official options but no expanded registry/build approval is authorized.
Packaged main inspector support must succeed without bypass; otherwise stop integration and report blocked.

Quit requested receipt is not exit proof. Confirm main/Host exit and natural lock release, restart same D profile, verify persistence and receipt lifecycle. Do not bypass any native task confirmation.
Temporary debug ports must close and ordinary Desktop startup must be restored. Bootstrap termination is not normal-shutdown evidence.
A v2 final frozen candidate requires separate Checker Gate before installation.
limitations: No real Desktop CDP or main inspector session exercised by Checker in this preflight.
VM and fixture tests do not establish official Desktop load/slot registration/persistence/shutdown.
No broader product or UI acceptance.
